rules.title: Cartwright Act: ban on using or distributing a common pricing algorithm as part of a restraint of trade
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of the Cartwright Act.
rules.coverage_text: Any person (not including the end consumer of a product or service) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm. This means any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term. Distributing includes selling, licensing, providing access to, or making it available by subscription.
rules.exemptions: The definition of person does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(a) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: The digest states that a violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (a) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm as part of a contract, combination in the form of a trust, or conspiracy to restrain trade or commerce in violation of this chapter.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.

rules.title: Cartwright Act: ban on coercing adoption of common pricing algorithm recommendations
rules.requirement: A person may not use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if that person coerces another person to set or adopt a price or commercial term recommended by the algorithm. This applies to the same or similar products or services in California.
rules.coverage_text: Any person (not including the end consumer of a product or service) who uses or distributes a common pricing algorithm. This means any methodology, including a computer, software, or other technology, used by two or more persons, that uses competitor data to recommend, align, stabilize, set, or otherwise influence a price or commercial term. Commercial terms include level of service, availability and output.
rules.exemptions: The definition of person does not include the end consumer of a product or service.
rules.citation: Business and Professions Code Section 16729(b) (AB 325, Chapter 338)
rules.penalty: The digest states that a violation of the Cartwright Act is punishable as a crime.
rules.quoted_span: (b) It shall be unlawful for a person to use or distribute a common pricing algorithm if the person coerces another person to set or adopt a recommended price or commercial term recommended by the common pricing algorithm for the same or similar products or services in the jurisdiction of this state.
rules.interaction_text: (c) Nothing in this section shall impair or limit the applicability of antitrust laws.
